environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed on EKS behind an Envoy sidecar (Istio service mesh 1.19). The mesh-wide EnvoyFilter resource applies a Lua filter at the SIDECAR_INBOUND listener on the HTTP_FILTER chain that appends response headers post-routing. The filter is defined in a namespace-scoped EnvoyFilter CR with workloadSelector matching the search-service pod label. The Lua script sets the Content-Security-Policy header to a nonce-less strict policy. Additionally, the Istio PeerAuthentication enforces mTLS STRICT mode on the namespace, and a Sidecar resource restricts egress to only the mesh internal services. The EnvoyFilter patch context is SIDECAR_INBOUND with RESPONSE_HEADERS phase insertion, ensuring it applies regardless of application-level header settings.

config.note: CSP header is injected at Envoy proxy layer before response reaches client, overriding any application omission
